{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.70

|gr1= Vehicle Loadouts

|descr=Set count of ammo in magazine on pylon (supports pylon name since Arma 3 v1.94)

|s1= vehicle [[setAmmoOnPylon]] [pylon, ammocount]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= pylon: [[Number]] or [[String]] - pylon index (index starts from 1) or pylon name (see [[getCompatiblePylonMagazines]] Example 4)

|p3= ammocount: [[Number]] - ammo count

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>vehicle player setAmmoOnPylon [1, 12];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>vehicle player setAmmoOnPylon ["pylon1", 12];</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Vehicle Loadouts]] [[getCompatiblePylonMagazines]] [[getPylonMagazines]] [[animatePylon]] [[animateBay]] [[setPylonsPriority]] [[setPylonLoadout]] [[setMagazineTurretAmmo]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Commy2
|timestamp= 20170818142000
|text= The pylon indices start at 1 and not at 0.
}}
